response: Estradiol and antagonist pretreatment prior to microdose leuprolide in in vitro fertilization (IVF) may improve IVF outcomes in poor responders. Compared to oral contraceptive pill (OCP) pretreatment, estradiol and antagonist pretreatment has been shown to have similar or slightly better outcomes in terms of pregnancy rates, embryo quality, and live birth rates. However, the evidence is not conclusive, and more research is needed to determine the optimal pretreatment protocol for poor responders undergoing IVF.
